# teltonika_rms_task_groups (Data Source)

Lists every task group visible to the token (`GET /devices/tasks/groups`, paginated transparently). Only group metadata is returned; use `teltonika_rms_task_group` (singular) to fetch a group's task list as well.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "teltonika_rms_task_groups" "all" {}

output "group_count" {
  value = length(data.teltonika_rms_task_groups.all.task_groups)
}
```
